title: Retail loyalty points platform, from a written note and a fresher interview that contradicts it
provenance: Synthetic system authored for this corpus (issue #64). Not derived from, or sanitized from, any real system or any real conversation: there is nothing to leak by omission. The transcript's form follows the properties measured from real exports in #51 — attribution by participant name, no uncertainty markers, cleaned turns — with invented content.
notes: Authored for issue #64: the corpus's first two-source case and first transcript, built to grade the conversational rules (#53) and the two-source conflict rule (#55), which no other case exercises. Four traps, each recorded as a correction: a hedge that must stay unknown (the spoofing must-find rests on it), a fact inside a question that must produce no flow, a mid-turn self-correction and a hypothetical that must produce no elements (element-level, because score_extraction is attribute-blind), and an exposure the two sources contradict, which flattens to unknown and carries an elevation-of-privilege must-find. Domain picked for clear air per #64: no ordering, no workforce, no supplier, no device estate, and no card data.
